author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a big ring head over a tube-outlined body on all fours - arm reaching down-left to the floor, flat back, hip curving into the folded leg and foot; reads as a crawling baby like the reference. The rejected drawing was heavy and blunt. A first HRECT_L candidate was too squat; the SQUARE version has a longer arm.
omissions: Only the near arm and leg are drawn, as in the reference.
drawing_plan: SQUARE: head r5 at (20,11), exactly 8 above the separate flat back line y 24 (x 17..28); outline: r8 hip to (36,32), r5 foot cap to (37,42), shin bottom to (27,42), thigh front to belly y 32, 45-degree arm (x+y 41/55) with r5 hand cap centred (11,37).
lucide_reference: Lucide 'baby': large head over a crawling silhouette.
